meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计科学的实验方案，让结论更可靠
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在实验前拿不准怎么分组和随机化。
copy.tagline_en: Design rigorous experiments that yield trustworthy conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning an experiment and unsure about group assignment and randomization.

howto.what: Claude 会先帮你把实验设计定下来：选设计类型、随机分组、用区组消除干扰因素，并用脚本生成带随机种子的分组表或 DOE 运行表，供你照做和归档。
howto.when: 当你在收数据前规划研究、问怎么把受试者或样本分配到各组，或提到随机化、区组、析因设计等时接管；数据已收集后的分析请改用 statistical-analysis。

say.text: 我要把 60 只小鼠分到处理组和对照组，帮我做随机分组表
say.note: 会生成带种子、可复现的分组表 CSV。

say.text: 我要筛选 7 个因素，帮我出一个 Plackett-Burman 设计
say.note: 输出真实单位、运行顺序随机的 DOE 表。

say.text: 样本要分两天跑，怎么设计才能不和批次混淆？
say.note: 给出区组或跨批次随机化的安排。

howto.what_en: Claude first settles the design: choosing a design type, randomizing assignment, blocking nuisance factors, and generating a seeded allocation schedule or DOE run layout you can follow and archive.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a study before collecting data, ask how to assign subjects or samples to groups, or mention randomization, blocking, factorial designs and similar terms. For data already collected, use statistical-analysis instead.

say_en.text: Assign 60 mice to treatment and control groups and give me a randomization table
Screen 7 factors for me with a Plackett-Burman design
say_en.note: Returns a DOE table in real units, randomized run order.

say_en.text: Samples run across two days — how do I design this to avoid batch confounding?
say_en.note: Suggests blocking or randomizing across batches.
